group.label: IndexNow Protocol
group.comment: Instantly notify Bing, Yandex, and other participating search engines when content changes. Learn more.

field.label: Enable IndexNow
field.comment: When enabled, product, category, and CMS page saves automatically submit the changed URL to IndexNow.

field.label: API Key
field.comment: 8 to 128 characters: letters, digits and dashes (e.g. a1b2c3d4e5f6...). Generate one at Bing IndexNow. The key is served at /<key>.txt and /panth_indexnow/key for verification.

field.label: Submit Deleted URLs
field.comment: When enabled, the URL of a deleted product, category or CMS page is submitted so search engines recrawl it and drop it from their index.

field.label: Submission Mode
field.comment: Changed URLs are always stored in a queue table. "At the end of the request" submits them when the save request finishes, with a 4 second timeout. "By cron" leaves the save request untouched and lets the panth_index_now_flush cron job submit the queue every minute. In both modes the cron job retries URLs that could not be submitted.
